title: Blessings for Charat Singh and the Opening of the Brar Rift

blocks.text: The surviving caravan closes the Ghallughara sequence by blessing Charat Singh for the courage and protection he showed throughout the retreat. Voices around him say that the entire Khalsa Panth might accept his leadership, imagining a future in which his authority and renown spread far beyond the present battlefield.

Those blessings also carry a practical judgment: wherever Charat Singh moves, the Khalsa will trust him to guide, defend, and regroup them after catastrophe. The page therefore ends Episode 136 not with triumph, but with gratitude and political hope born from communal survival.

It then turns sharply into a new conflict by opening the rift between the Singhs and the Brars. The same survivors who have escaped massacre now enter Malwa expecting relief, only to find insult, exploitation, and a fresh round of hostility.
